name: mmlx-lsp
description: MML language support powered by mmlx and WebAssembly.

input.description: MML or MDX input path. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to mmlx.build.format. Both generates MDX and VGM for MML, or VGM for MDX input.

output.description: Output path. Overrides mmlx.build.outputDirectory. For both formats, use a base path; an existing .mdx or .vgm suffix is replaced with each output extension.

pdx.description: PDX path for VGM output. Defaults to the referenced PDX beside the input file.

adpcmMode.description: ADPCM processing mode for VGM output.

loopCount.description: Finite VGM loop count. If omitted, preserve native VGM loop points.

maxTicks.description: Maximum playback ticks for VGM conversion.

mmlx.dialect.description: MML dialect used by the language server. Currently only MDX is supported. Run mmlx: Restart Language Server after changing this setting.

mmlx.language.description: Language for completion and argument hints. Auto follows the editor locale, with Japanese as the fallback. Run mmlx: Restart Language Server after changing this setting.

mmlx.build.format.description: Default build outputs. Both generates MDX and VGM from MML; MDX input produces VGM only. An explicit task format or individual build command overrides this setting.

mmlx.build.onSave.description: Build MML files when saved in a trusted workspace, using the configured build format and output directory. Consecutive saves are combined and builds of the same file are serialized.

mmlx.build.outputDirectory.description: Build output directory. Relative paths are resolved from the task workspace folder, or the input directory if there is no workspace folder. Absolute paths are also accepted. A task's output property overrides this setting.

mmlx.build.pdx.description: Default PDX file for VGM conversion and NanoDrive8 Playback. Empty discovers the referenced PDX beside the input. An explicit task pdx overrides this setting for builds.

mmlx.build.adpcmMode.description: Default ADPCM processing mode for VGM output and NanoDrive8 Playback. An explicit task adpcmMode overrides this setting for builds.

mmlx.build.loopCount.description: Default VGM playthrough count. Zero preserves native loop points; positive values create finite output. An explicit task loopCount overrides this setting.

mmlx.serial.connection.description: Serial port path selected for NanoDrive8. Empty means no port selected. Selection does not open the port or transmit data.

mmlx.midi.input.description: MIDI input port name selected on the extension host. Empty means no port selected. Selection does not open the port or receive MIDI messages.

mmlx.build.maxTicks.description: Default maximum playback ticks for VGM conversion. An explicit task maxTicks overrides this setting.

semanticTokenTypes.description: MML notes. Uses the theme's normal editor foreground by default.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run compile
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:server && npm run build:compiler && npm run build:emulator && npm run build:nanodrive
scripts.build:nanodrive: cargo build --locked -j 1 --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --features nanodrive --bin mmlx-nanodrive --release --target wasm32-wasip1-threads
scripts.build:emulator: cargo build --locked -j 1 --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --features emulation --bin mmlx-emulator --release --target wasm32-wasip1-threads && npm run build:browser-emulator
scripts.build:browser-emulator: cargo build --locked -j 1 --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --features emulation --bin mmlx-emulator --release --target wasm32-wasip1
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run build:wasm && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run compile-tests
